title: Carrier Partnerships Manager
description:

This role will serve as the primary commercial liaison between the organization and carrier partners, driving network utilization, onboarding new carriers, supporting operational integration, and identifying opportunities that increase parcel volume through the network.
The ideal candidate brings a strong background in parcel transportation, last-mile delivery, carrier operations, and business development. They must possess a deep understanding of carrier networks, delivery economics, alternative delivery solutions, and the challenges facing carriers in dense urban and suburban markets.

title: Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security
description: Datamint | Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security | Remote (Global) | Full-time | $120k-$170k + Equity | https://datamint.xyz We build high-throughput crawling and structured data extraction infra designed for AI agents and LLM pipelines. If you’ve built scrapers recently, you already know the state of the market: - Traditional proxy providers (Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, Proxybase) give you raw IPs or massive unparsed HTML blobs, leaving you to deal with DOM bloat, token waste, and brittle parsing pipelines. - Modern tools like Firecrawl or Jina made clean Markdown extraction easy for hobby setups, but they often struggle when you throw heavy SPAs, high-concurrency jobs, or hardened anti-bot walls (Cloudflare Under-Attack / Turnstile, Kasada, DataDome) at them. - Rolling your own Playwright / Puppeteer cluster works until target sites deploy new JA4/TLS fingerprints, and your data team ends up spending 30% of their sprints fixing broken crawlers instead of shipping product. We're tackling this by combining a low-latency Rust fast-fetch engine (JA4/TLS and HTTP/2 frame emulation) with an isolated stealth browser fleet, zero-code schema validation (JSON Schema/Pydantic), and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support. Trade-offs / where we fit: If you just need to curl a few static Wikipedia pages, a 10-line Python script is better and cheaper. But if you need reliable, structured data out of bot-defended sites without babying headless browsers, that's what we do. We're looking for: 1. Rust Systems Engineer: High-concurrency network I/O, Axum/Tokio, TLS/BoringSSL fingerprinting, proxy routing matrices, and low-latency data pipelines. 2. Browser Security Engineer: Deep familiarity with browser internals (Firefox/Chromium source), canvas/WebGL/audio fingerprint evasion, CDP/WebDriver stealth, and familarity with anti-bot defenses. Our stack: Rust, Next.js 16/React 19, TypeScript, hardened Firefox/dwx_crawler, Linux/Xvfb, SQLite WAL/Postgres. If interested, shoot an email to jobs@datamint.xyz (or founders@datamint.xyz) with your GitHub, a project you built or broke, and what you find interesting in this space. No formal cover letter needed.

description:

Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: 4C Integrity Auditor (Freelancer) - Regional focus East and West Africa, Asia,
locationText: Brazil, Canada, India, Mexico, South Africa, United States
description:
your tasks
4C (Certification for Climate, Conservation, and Communities) is a global certification scheme for sustainable coffee and cocoa. 4C certification focuses on good agricultural and management practices, including requirements on economic, social, and environmental conditions for coffee production and processing in order to establish credible, sustainable, and transparent supply chains. Independent certification bodies verify compliance with the 4C requirements. 4C was developed in a comprehensive and transparent multi-stakeholder process involving coffee/cocoa producers, trade and industry, as well as organizations from civil society around the world. 4C aims to move the entire coffee or cocoa sector towards sustainability practices. 4C operates in 25 countries and is one of the largest certification systems in the coffee sector.

Since 2020, the 4C System has evolved into a robust, benchmarked standard, defining clear social, environmental, and economic criteria. Alongside certification, we provide innovative solutions to help companies comply with global regulations and strengthen responsible supply chains in a changing world.

4C Services GmbH, the operator of 4C certification system, is seeking to recruit a highly motivated freelance auditor to conduct integrity assessments within the framework of the 4C Integrity Program.

Key activities:

• Planning, preparing, and conducting 4C integrity assessments at certified 4C Units, Intermediary and Final Buyers of 4C certified coffee and Certification Bodies cooperation with 4C, with focus on:

• Traceability

• Social issues such as child labour, forced labour, fair and safe working conditions

• Environmental issues such as deforestation, biodiversity and soil conservation, and pesticide use

• General support to 4C System users in countries of East and West Africa, Asia, or Latin America regarding communication, meetings, translation of documents, etc.

• Contribution to the continuous development of the 4C System and the 4C Integrity Program

your profile

• A minimum of five years of professional experience in certification or quality assurance, auditing or verification; At least a Bachelor University degree and Agricultural production background

•
Audit experience with certification systems such as 4C, Rainforest Alliance, CAFÉ Practices, Global G.A.P

• Experience in supply chains for agricultural products, preferably in the area of coffee and/or cocoa

•
High proficiency in English and relevant local languages when applicable (French, Spanish, Portuguese, or Vietnamese) (spoken and written). Additional languages are of advantage

• Good knowledge of the relevant tools/ software (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and/or GIS or remote sensing-based software/application for risk assessment)

• High willingness and availability to travel

• High level of commitment, proficiency and assertiveness

• Structured, accurate and independent working style

Important note:

4C Integrity Auditors must be completely independent and free of conflict of interest with 4C System Users ().
This means the 4C Integrity Auditor cannot be employed or contracted as a consultant by a Certification Body or any 4C System User operating in the coffee/cocoa sector at the same time as working as a 4C Integrity Auditor.
why us?

• Remote work and flexible working hours

• Competitive compensation

• Professional onboarding to help you have an ideal start with us

• Close collaboration with our sister companies Meo Carbon Solutions, ISCC System GmbH, and GRAS Global Risk Assessment Services, giving you even more learning opportunities

• The opportunity to work independently and shape processes

ready to join our team?

title: Power Delivery Lead (MV Distribution)
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE POWER GENERATION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Build an islanded grid at gigawatt scale, from a blank sheet. Generation, storage and compute running with no utility behind them, where the machine you design is the only thing holding voltage. No playbook exists at this size, so the architecture you set becomes the reference.

- Get power online in months, not years. Interconnection queues are measured in years and we do not have them. Generating our own power is how a site goes from signed lease to live compute inside six months, and the power system is the long pole in that plan.

- Make one power block, then build it a thousand times. A repeatable block and cluster unit, validated once and stamped across the fleet, is the only route to the scale we are targeting. Every bespoke site is schedule we do not get back.

- Design a grid whose largest load answers back. Compute is not passive demand here. Load behaviour, curtailment and shedding are design variables you negotiate and specify, a lever almost no power system engineer has ever been handed.

ROLE SCOPE

- Design the medium-voltage network that carries power from each generation block to the data halls, inside the system design basis, as one standard that every site deploys and that grows by adding blocks rather than by redesign.

- Design the cluster tie and MV substations that bundle blocks together, covering bus arrangement, transformer selection, tie and transfer schemes, and the switching sequences that let a new block energize next to live ones without an outage.

- Size feeders, cable and transformers to the load and run the network studies behind them yourself, including load flow, voltage drop, short circuit, protection coordination, and EMT studies of switching, energization and islanded transients, as models that rerun for each site's layout and block count.

- Set the protection philosophy and relay settings for an inverter-dominated network with limited fault current, and write the standard specifications for MV switchgear, transformers, cable and relaying that ship with every block.

- Define the envelope the standard holds for, covering block count, feeder length, fault level and load step, set the triggers that send a site to a site-specific study, and fold what each energized site teaches back into the next revision.

description:
【岗位定位】
1、公司已经建立较完善的数据仓库和实时数据体系，具备数据采集、计算、存储及服务能力。随着业务规模增长和实时应用场景增加，我们希望引入两名中高级数据开发工程师，负责实时数据需求交付、任务优化及工程治理。
2、该岗位以实时数据开发为主，同时参与离线数仓建设。你将重点解决实时链路中的数据延迟、状态膨胀、资源消耗、数据质量及一致性等问题，推动实时数据体系向更稳定、更高效、更规范的方向演进。
【岗位职责】
1、负责实时数据需求的分析、方案设计和开发交付，基于Flink、Kafka等技术建设实时数据处理链路，为实时分析、监控、指标及业务决策等场景提供数据支持。
2、参与实时数仓建设及模型设计，结合业务需求完成数据分层、指标口径、维度模型和数据服务的设计与落地。
3、持续优化现有实时任务，解决数据延迟、反压、Checkpoint异常、状态膨胀、资源利用率不合理及数据不一致等问题，提升任务稳定性和计算效率。
4、参与数据治理和工程质量建设，包括任务依赖梳理、元数据管理、数据质量监控、告警机制、开发规范及问题排查体系建设。
5、参与大数据平台及计算引擎的日常维护和问题处理，协同上下游团队保障数据链路的稳定性、准确性和时效性。
6、沉淀实时开发最佳实践和技术经验，通过技术分享、代码评审及方案评审，提升团队整体实时研发能力。
【任职要求】
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息技术或相关专业，具有5年及以上数据开发或大数据研发经验；能力优秀者可适当放宽。
2、具备完整的数据仓库项目经验，熟悉实时数仓架构、数据分层和数据模型设计，能够将业务需求转化为数据模型及技术方案。
3、熟练掌握Flink，具有Flink SQL、DataStream API等实际项目经验，理解State、Checkpoint、Watermark、窗口、反压和容错机制。
4、具备实时任务开发及优化经验，能够独立分析和解决任务延迟、资源消耗较高、状态异常、数据倾斜及数据一致性等问题。
5、熟悉Kafka及实时数据链路，理解数据采集、传输、计算、存储和服务的完整流程。
6、熟悉Hadoop、Hive、Spark等大数据技术，具备一定的离线数据开发能力。
7、熟练掌握SQL，能够完成复杂数据加工和性能优化；至少熟悉Python、Java或Scala中的一种开发语言。
8、熟悉MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch等常用数据库或存储系统。
9、具备良好的业务理解、沟通协作和书面表达能力，责任心强，能够主动推动问题解决和项目落地。
【加分项】
1、具有大规模Flink任务开发、性能调优或集群治理经验。
2、具有实时数仓架构优化、实时链路治理或技术升级经验。
3、熟悉Hologres、ClickHouse、Doris等实时OLAP技术。
4、具有实时指标、实时监控、实时风控、实时推荐等复杂业务场景经验。
【我们期待的候选人】
1、我们希望你不仅能够完成数据需求开发，也愿意深入理解实时计算机制，关注数据链路的稳定性、性能和工程质量。
2、面对复杂问题，你能够从数据、代码、任务配置和运行机制等多个角度定位原因，并将解决方案沉淀为可复用的规范、工具或最佳实践。

Join Project Melora - German Voice Recording ($17.20-$43)
Help build more natural voice AI by recording short, one-sided phone calls in German. Imagine you're calling a bank, telco, or retailer for help, and speak naturally using made-up details. Each session takes only a few minutes.
Requirements

Native German speaker, 18+
Can read and follow short instructions in German
Own an iPhone 17, 17 Air, 17 Pro, or 17 Pro Max
Have a quiet indoor space to record (no TV, traffic, fans, or other voices)
Can complete 4-10 calls, each 1-2 minutes (5 minutes max)
Can spread calls out: no more than 3 per day, at least 3 hours apart, at different times of day across several days
Comfortable improvising a natural, unscripted call that follows a 6-step flow: greeting, ID verification, describing the issue, pausing for the agent's reply, resolution, and closing
Will use only fake names and account or order numbers (no real personal information)
Willing to be recorded, give recorded consent, sign an NDA, and follow project guidelines

How it works

Record solo calls on our secure platform. No second person is needed; pause where the agent would respond.
Submit basic metadata after each call.

Pay: $4.30 per QA-approved session

You need at least 4 approved sessions to be paid ($17.20), and you can do up to 10 ($43.00).
Sessions that fail QA don't count toward payment.
We recommend doing all 10 to get the full payout.

Why join? It's flexible and remote, you work on your own schedule, and pay is always above minimum wage in your market.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Solutions
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager for Solutions, you will be owning the positioning and messaging for 5-7 industries and will be responsible for setting the go-to-market strategy for integrating new technologies and features into Verkada’s broader marketing and sales efforts. This role is highly cross-functional and will work closely with key stakeholders across the Product, Sales, and Marketing organizations. 

You will be integral in developing the collateral needed to support GTM motions in these industries and develop new ways for teams across Verkada to reach and communicate with existing and prospective customers.

What’s You’ll Do

• Develop industry positioning and competitively differentiated messaging based on customer research, industry insights, and product knowledge.

• Bring new products and features to market through an industry lens by taking the lead on content creation - planning, creating/managing deliverables and timelines in order to maximize impact

• Work closely with Brand, Creative, and Demand Generation teams to increase market presence and drive pipeline through key outbound assets (video, webinars, thought leadership, tradeshow collateral, email nurture, etc).

• Partner with Channel and Sales Enablement teams to effectively position our products, leveraging internal tools and developing assets that help improve win rates.

• Become an industry subject matter expert, evangelist, and cross-functional leader who unites Marketing, Sales, and Enablement teams to drive business results.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS or IoT

• Bachelor’s required

• MBA preferred or graduating from an accredited MBA program in 2027

• Ideal candidates have experience developing positioning and messaging across a portfolio of products

• Self-directed and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

• Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences

• Experience working cross-functionally with teams including Demand Generation, Sales, Creative, Enablement, and Product.

• Willingness to travel domestically for events and conferences

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions

What You Bring

• Execution Bias & Technical Grit: You thrive in the high-ambiguity phase of a zero-to-one build. You are a builder who prioritizes shipping high-utility foundations over perfect abstractions, with a proven ability to translate a high-level vision into a tangible, functioning platform in weeks, not months.

• UI Depth & Sophistication: You have led the development of highly complex, state-heavy web or mobile applications. You understand the performance trade-offs of rendering thousands of interactive entities and have a deep grasp of modern frontend architectures (React, WebGL/WebGPU, Swift/Kotlin).

• Data Pipeline & ML Maturity: You have experience building sophisticated data pipelines that handle unstructured data at scale.

title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing.

- Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods.

- Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors.

- Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation.

- Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

- Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration.

- Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability.

- Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics.

- Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization.

- Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements.

Your Qualifications

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

- At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration.

- Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection.

- Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus.

- A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures.

- Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
12twenty is the leading platform for employers to connect with elite early career professionals. Our community includes millions of students, recent graduates, and alumni from top business schools, law schools, and universities around the world. We take pride connecting our community of candidates with recruiters from top companies across industries. Come join our fast growing organization!

Senior Product Marketing Manager

About the Role

12twenty is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own product marketing for a dedicated line of business. You’ll connect Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, building a deep understanding of our products and turning that knowledge into clear value propositions, effective sales enablement, and thoughtful go-to-market plans.

You’ll operate at both strategic and executional levels, helping us sharpen our positioning, prepare our teams, and bring products to market with a clear understanding of who they’re for and why they matter.

We’re looking for someone who asks good questions, gets close to customers, and can turn complex capabilities into a compelling answer to “Why should I care?”

Product Understanding, Positioning & Value Propositions

• Build deep knowledge of the products within your line of business, including their capabilities, use cases, limitations, and customer outcomes.

• Own product positioning and value propositions grounded in customer needs, buying behavior, and competitive differentiation.

• Translate product capabilities into clear benefits tailored to specific ICPs, personas, and use cases.

• Partner with Marketing to develop clear, compelling go-to-market messaging grounded in product value, customer insights, and the broader 12twenty narrative.

• Validate product claims and develop the customer evidence and proof points that support them.

Go-to-Market Strategy & Launch Planning

• Own the go-to-market plan and launch calendar for your line of business, aligning timing and priorities with Product and go-to-market partners.

• Determine the appropriate launch approach for new products and features based on customer relevance, business opportunity, and team readiness.

• Partner with Product, CS, Sales, and Marketing to define target audiences, launch goals, packaging considerations, responsibilities, and success metrics.

• Coordinate launch readiness, including value propositions, enablement, customer communications, and the information teams need to sell and support the offering.

• Evaluate performance after launch and use customer feedback, adoption signals, and sales findings to improve the approach.

Sales & Customer Enablement

• In partnership with Marketing create and maintain practical enablement materials, including sales guides, decks, battlecards, use cases, objection handling, and competitive talking points.

• Partner with Sales and BDRs to understand where conversations stall and what would help buyers move forward.

• Equip CS with the information needed to communicate new capabilities and help customers understand their value.

• Gather feedback on enablement materials, track their use, and improve them based on what teams need in real conversations.

Market & Customer Intelligence

• Maintain a strong understanding of customer needs, buying behavior, decision criteria, and alternatives within your line of business.

• Conduct customer and buyer interviews, review sales conversations, and lead win/loss research to uncover what influences purchasing decisions.

• Refine ICPs, personas, and priority use cases based on evidence.

• Monitor competitive offerings, positioning, and market developments, translating findings into actionable guidance.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Lexroom http://lexroom.ai/ is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom http://lexroom.ai/.

We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.

Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

 

WHY LEXROOM http://lexroom.ai/?

- Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

- Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.

- Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work-faster, clearer, and more efficiently.

At Lexroom http://lexroom.ai/, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

THE ROLE

You will be one of the senior engineers in a squad of four to five, with a product manager and a designer. You will make the technical decisions for what the squad ships, own those decisions in production, and help the engineers around you get better. Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title.

You will work across the whole stack. We expect you to be deep on one side and fluent enough on the other to ship a feature alone when needed. If you are a strong backend engineer who has never touched React, or a strong frontend engineer who has never written Python, apply: we hire for judgment and curiosity, and we will tailor the interviews to where you are strongest.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least one system you owned end to end. Years alone are not the requirement; the evidence is.

- You have shipped and operated systems that real users depended on, and you can tell us what broke, what it cost and what you changed.

- You use AI coding tools every day (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) and you can say precisely where they were wrong and how you caught it.

- You review other people’s code as a habit, and people get better from your reviews.

- You speak and write English fluently: it is our working language across teams and countries. Italian is a plus.

OUR STACK

Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend, Python (Django and Django Ninja) on the backend, Postgres and vector stores, LLM pipelines built on our own AI platform, deployed on the cloud with GitHub Actions. You do not need to know all of it. You need to be able to learn the part you don’t know in weeks, not quarters.

 

THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF

- You have never been responsible for something running in production.

- You want a well-defined ticket to implement and someone else to decide.

- You see full-stack work as a compromise rather than as the way to ship.

 

WHAT SETS US APART

Vår vision är att vara den absolut bästa arbetsgivaren för en skicklig och ambitiös IT-konsult. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid dig då du är det viktigaste vi har. Klyschigt tänker du kanske? - helt sant menar vi!
Vem är du?
Ja, vem är du? Vad vill du göra? Vad brinner du för? Vi arbetar fram det uppdrag som går i linje med din plan för framtiden. Om du inte har någon plan så fixar vi en tillsammans!

Vad erbjuder vi?
Hos oss får du roliga uppdrag som du själv är med och styr över. Kompetensutveckling öser vi över dig och den är naturligtvis betald och individuell. title: Product Growth Engineer
description:
About Uno Platform

Uno Platform is an open‑source platform that lets developers build apps once in .NET and run them everywhere: Windows, Web, iOS, Android, macOS, and Linux. We build tools that make developers faster-visual tools, AI tools, and cross‑platform tooling-without taking control away from them. Thousands of developers use Uno in production today, and we are just getting started.
We are a lean team with global ambition. If you want comfort and process layers, this is not the place. If you want ownership and impact, keep reading.
The Role
We are looking for a Product Growth Engineer with 5+ years of experience driving measurable growth through experimentation.
This is a hands‑on role. You will own product‑led growth across acquisition, activation, and retention for Uno Platform and Uno Platform Studio. You will work closely with product, engineering, and leadership to ship experiments, measure impact, and scale what works.
In this role, you will:

• Run rapid growth experiments across website, onboarding, product flows, and campaigns

• Improve conversion from visitor to active user to paying customer

• Build and optimize growth funnels end to end

• Use product data to identify friction and opportunities

• Analyze in‑product behavior using Azure telemetry and Application Insights

• Partner with engineering to embed growth directly into the product

• Launch experiments and landing pages with minimal process

• Focus on metrics that matter, not vanity metrics

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years in growth, product growth, performance marketing, or similar hands‑on roles

• Proven ability to move real business or product metrics

• Strong analytical skills and comfort with product data and dashboards

• Ability to work closely with engineers and product teams

• Builder mindset: you prefer testing over debating

• Comfortable in a fast‑moving environment with real ownership

Nice to have:

• Experience with Azure telemetry or Application Insights

• Experience with developer tools, SaaS, or technical products

• Experience working in Microsoft developer ecosystem

• Experience working with open‑source communities

Why This Role Matters
Uno Platform is already used by developers around the world, but we are still early in our growth. This role directly shapes how developers discover, adopt, and succeed with our tools. The impact is tangible: faster growth, better product adoption, and more developers empowered to build real applications at scale.

title: Treasury Operations Analyst
description:
ROLE

Taptap Send is seeking a highly organised and motivated individual to join our Treasury Operations team and help us grow our business. In this role, you will report to the Director of Payments and touch all aspects of Taptap Send's payment operations, with an initial focus on stablecoin funding, working directly with our teams and partners across the world.

You'll own the full life cycle of payments, including creating, tracking and confirming crediting of funds, as well as troubleshooting payment issues across our growing Stablecoin operations. You'll also be involved in funding forecasts to ensure that our partners are well funded at all times.

You'll work directly with our trading team as well as collaborating with the wider team that spans the globe ( London, Abidjan, Lagos, Nairobi, Paris and New York, to name a few places), ensuring that Taptap Send is effectively supported in its growth and customer ambitions! There is plenty of room for professional progression and personal growth within our friendly and ever-growing Taptap community.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Proactively managing treasury operations, initially for stablecoins, to ensure our accounts are funded and payments can be processed seamlessly

- Working closely with partners to ensure that funding timelines are being delivered on time

- Troubleshooting to find root causes of payment issues and working with internal and external partners to resolve

- Assisting with onboarding new banks and trading partners for stablecoin, working closely with our business development team

- Providing out-of-hours coverage when required

REQUIREMENTS

- Have at least 1 years’ experience, ideally in a payments or funding role and/or working with stablecoins

- Are passionate about our mission and eager to do what needs to be done to achieve it

- Are enthusiastic about treasury operations, solving unique problems, and optimizing processes

- Enjoy challenges, are resourceful and think outside the box to find creative ways to tackle problems

- Love working in teams and building meaningful relationships with key stakeholders

- Don’t hesitate to place a call to promptly resolve issues or persevere to get a result

- Have great organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a fast-paced startup environment where no two days are the same

- Have proven analytical skills (Excel); SQL a plus

- Are proficient in English

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

- Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

- Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

- Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

- Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

- Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

- Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

- Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

- Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

- Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

- Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

- Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

WHAT YOU NEED

- 2-4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

- Solid grounding in business customer due diligence: company registers, UBO identification, sanctions/PEP screening, and spotting red flags

- Fluent English, written and verbal

- Clear, friendly written communication with customers

- Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make casework faster and better

- Based in, or relocating to, Stockholm, with the right to work in Sweden

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Swedish (strongly preferred)

- Familiarity with Swedish sources and requirements (Bolagsverket, the beneficial ownership register, FI expectations under the Swedish AML Act)

- Experience onboarding EU businesses across several jurisdictions

- An additional European language

title: Engineering Manager – Camera Firmware Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Team

The Camera Firmware Platform team owns the foundation that every Verkada camera runs on. While our product firmware teams bring new camera categories to market, this team makes every camera in the fleet, both existing and future models, more reliable, faster, leaner, and more power-efficient.

• Edge Storage: We own the on-camera storage stack that turns every Verkada camera into a self-contained recording device. Our mandate is reliable, accessible, secure, and observable storage of customer video. Footage is preserved instantly across SD cards and raw NAND, even during network outages or sudden power loss, for millions of cameras and petabytes of video. This extends to the backend services that manage retention, cloud backup, and storage health across the fleet.

• Firmware Platform: Building on that foundation, we own the cross-cutting firmware systems underneath every camera feature: boot and shutdown, memory and power management, system state orchestration, IPC, observability, and firmware update. We build these once, for every camera model and SoC, so product teams can move fast without rebuilding the same infrastructure.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager for Camera Firmware Platform, you will lead a highly technical team of storage and embedded systems engineers responsible for the reliability, performance, power, and stability of firmware running on a fleet of more than 1.8 million perpetually online devices. You will set the storage and platform roadmap, decide which fleet-wide investments matter most, and turn them into measurable improvements in footage retention, storage endurance, boot time, memory headroom, power draw, and crash rates.

You will partner closely with the Camera Firmware product team, Hardware, Streaming, Computer Vision, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Manufacturing, and Product. You will also work with Verkada Linux, the shared OS layer across all Verkada product lines, to incubate platform capabilities on cameras and contribute them back for use across the company product lines.

This role combines deep technical leadership with people management. We are committed to a thriving in-office culture, and this role requires onsite presence at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Do

Lead the team

• Lead and grow a team of storage, firmware, and systems engineers, and recruit and retain top-tier embedded talent as the team expands its charter.

• Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, career development, and execution management.

• Define the technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap for camera storage and firmware platform, balancing fleet-wide investments against support for new camera launches.

• Establish engineering best practices around testing, observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term maintainabili

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

About the Role
Services Support Specialists are the dedicated, global point of contact for HumanSignal 's contractor population - a workforce-operations function distinct from Enterprise Support. Where Enterprise Support is primarily technical and customer-facing, this role resolves payment, identity/verification, account-access, onboarding, and project-related questions for contractors working across every timezone.
Key Responsibilities

• Own and resolve inbound contractor tickets in Zendesk, including payment/payout issues, identity and KYC verification, account access, and onboarding or assessment blockers.

• Serve as a contractor's single point of contact, coordinating across teams rather than leaving them to navigate multiple channels on their own.

• Escalate issues outside Services Support's scope to the appropriate team: Payments/Finance, Verification/Trust, Project Operations, Support Engineering/Engineering, or Safety/Security.

• Monitor and handle annotator requests within Discord, escalating to the appropriate delivery team resource when needed.

• Apply P0-P3 severity classification to incoming tickets and follow the corresponding response process.

• Identify and flag repetitive, low-complexity ticket types (roughly 81% of tickets require two or fewer agent comments) for deterministic self-service or automation.

• Participate in a quarterly review of ticket volume and coverage against the schedule below.

On-Call Responsibilities

• Acknowledge P0 pages within approximately 15 minutes; unacknowledged pages automatically escalate to that week's secondary on-call responder.

• On-call is reserved for Critical issues only - for example, a systemic inability to work, widespread payment or verification failures, major production incidents, or credible safety/security concerns. Routine P1-P3 tickets remain queued for the next scheduled shift.

title: Clinical Project Coordinator
description:
Provide administrative, clerical, implementation and/or processing support to the project teams and stakeholders. Assist with document/process/report development, testing, tracking, distribution, and management. Coordinate meetings, presentations, and training activities, facilitate billing and payment activities, and act as first point of contact for project queries. Ensure that all activities align with quality standards, project guidelines, corporate best practices, and regulatory standards and guidelines.
Project Support

• Prepare and coordinate flow of documents, materials, and resources for project meetings and presentations, preparing meeting agendas, minutes and documents, scheduling and coordinating project committees, sponsor and site meetings, and tracking training programs and activities

• Facilitate project invoicing, billing and payment document preparation including support documents, and assist with internal and external communications throughout the project life cycle.

Document Management

• Assist team, providing timely administrative support, including form preparation, client/project information entry, creating logs, reports, and scripts

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of project forms, documents and processes during the project life cycle and assist with project issue identification and resolution during audits that is consistent with project requirements.

Client/Sponsor Support

• Act as first point of contact for project queries, appropriately identifying, addressing, redirecting or escalating questions, protocol clarification requests and project/service issues appropriately, that are consistent with project requirements, regulatory standards and corporate code of conduct.
Document Control

• Manage and maintain project materials, tools, equipment and supplies, ensuring all activity is entered/recorded, distributed, tracked, monitored, updated, revised and/or maintained in accordance with project protocols, industry best practices and regulatory standards and guidelines.
